Hi there — happy to help. In most areas where you manage saved views, the rename option can be accessed from the saved view’s “…” (more) menu next to the view name (or via a right-click on the saved view in the list). 

To point you to the exact menu and the right docs page, could you confirm which product/app this is in (the workspace or module name), and where you’re seeing the saved views list (e.g., on a specific page or under a specific sidebar/header)? If you can share the exact UI label you see near the view list (or a screenshot), that’s even better.

Once I have that, I’ll send the correct steps/menu location for renaming your saved view (and note whether shared/team views require different permissions).
